headline: Bring Advantage Air climate control into Home Assistant
intro: Connect an Advantage Air controller through its wall-mounted Android tablet to manage air conditioning systems and temperature-controlled zones. Home Assistant can also expose zone covers, sensors, and supported MyPlace lights, blinds, garage doors, and relays.
highlights: Set a static IP for the tablet running MyPlace, e-zone, or zone10e, then enter it during setup
Use climate entities for the system and temperature-controlled zones; supported controllers may also expose covers, sensors, lights, blinds, garage doors, and relays
Adjust non-temperature-controlled zone covers in 5% increments and use advantage_air.set_time_to for time-to-on and time-to-off settings

flow.title: From Advantage Air tablet to zone controls
stages: Assign a static IP to the tablet running MyPlace, e-zone, or zone10e
Add Advantage Air in Home Assistant and enter the tablet's IP address
Use climate entities for the system and temperature-controlled zones, with other entities available according to the controller and hardware
